is_anopheles.evidence: Host-seeking mosquitoes of the Anopheles gambiae s.l. complex (predominantly An. coluzzii and An. arabiensis) were sampled using human landing catches (page 3).

reports_target_markers.evidence: Genotyping was performed for the Vgsc L1014F (kdr-w) target-site mutation using real-time PCR (pages 3, 5, Table 1).

reports_extractable_genotype_data.evidence: Table 1 (page 5) reports exact genotype counts (RR, RS, SS) and allele frequencies for L1014F in Anopheles coluzzii (n=199: 61 RR, 90 RS, 48 SS) and Anopheles arabiensis (n=127: 105 RR, 16 RS, 6 SS).

african_field_population.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected in the field in Goden village, central Burkina Faso (12°25' N, 1°21' W) by indoor and outdoor human landing catches in September 2020 (pages 2, 3).

is_primary_study.evidence: This is a primary research article detailing original field collections, human surveys, and molecular analyses conducted in 2020.

sub_country_location.evidence: Data are tied specifically to Goden village (12°25' N, 1°21' W), located 35 km east of Ouagadougou in central Burkina Faso (page 2).

temporal_resolution_within_3y.evidence: Collections were conducted over 8 nights between 9 and 25 September 2020 (page 3).

duplicate_risk.evidence: Mosquitoes were collected de novo by the authors for this specific 2020 field study in Goden village.

supplement.evidence: Complete genotype numbers for both vector species are fully presented in Table 1 of the main text.

assessment.summary: This study evaluated mosquito biting rhythms, human behaviour, and residual malaria transmission in Goden village, Burkina Faso in September 2020. A subsample of 326 field-collected mosquitoes (199 An. coluzzii and 127 An. arabiensis) was genotyped for the Vgsc L1014F (L995F) resistance mutation, providing full RR/RS/SS genotype distributions for both species in Table 1. No insecticide bioassays were performed.
